articles.title: Photos: First look at J&J’s Ottava surgical robot
articles.summary: Johnson & Johnson MedTech unveiled Ottava, a table-integrated soft-tissue surgical robot, after receiving FDA de novo authorization. The system embeds four robotic arms into the operating table to reduce operating-room footprint by 30-50% versus boom-and-cart systems, while using software, motors, and sensors to automate portions of setup and workflow. Ottava also connects to J&J’s Polyphonic digital ecosystem for procedure data collection, training, collaboration, and research.
articles.advisor_relevance: This is a concrete example of robotics moving deeper into healthcare workflows, with a large medtech company using automation, sensors, software, and data platforms to improve surgical efficiency and consistency.
